teaser: Three AgentiCCells sites by hand, then one by a commit: live over https in 87 seconds, a first version by Claude Code at 159.
core_idea: A website's many moving parts were already commodities; the factory turns assembling them into a commit, though the credentials were hard to set up.

quotes.text: Making a site is now a commit.
That it was not, even with an agent doing most of the work, shows how immature this part of the technology still is.
quotes.why: Why it should have been easier.
